content: At the current right-Piper fixture,20mm grasp/23mm align and16mm grasp/23mm align both produced full simulation successes but failed their real frozen-reference executions. A complete release/fold sequence also failed physically. Do not reuse simulation success or unchanged gripper width as proof of real stable retention or insertion. A new16mm/25mm/0.3N.m historical-bundle candidate also aborted at alignment after a45.8s lift-inspection pause; the pause and coupled settings prevent a one-factor causal claim. Do not wait for LLM image review while holding the arm.
applicability: Current right-only Piper, RGB-only, original speed, target socket3; per-attempt gripper settings and diagnostic intervention must remain separate.
count_unit: Three distinct real executions under different grasp/effort/align conditions; latest includes an explicit pause. Not fixed-policy reliability trials.
known_limits: Static real-width substitution assumes simulated object pose and cannot identify a unique parameter
One raw capture has unresolved timing/export rejection
Historical successful grasp heights are not validated under the present grip/contact state
One ordinary-ruler empty-gap observation58mm vs encoder59.5mm does not calibrate loaded aperture.
New stopped real recording is valid,2993frames/camera; original batch2 first export remains unresolved.

next_checks.when: A paired real execution failed despite simulation success
next_checks.check: Read the paired outcome and existing phase/contact evidence before repeating unchanged parameters.

next_checks.when: Plug is grasped but insertion differs
next_checks.check: Compare plug-to-gripper pose across lift, alignment and insertion; motor aperture alone is insufficient. Real relative pose is still UNKNOWN.

next_checks.check: Read new failed alignment and measured45.8s diagnostic-pause cost. Keep model review outside motor execution; choose a new supported repair rather than repeat this bundle.
